ai_methodology.training_process: Each ML model is trained on certain data to build AI for you. Initial exploratory data analysis identifying important features.
customization_steps: Export trained models in API-compatible format
Host on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Heroku, Google Cloud)
Web application makes HTTP requests to API
ongoing_maintenance: Scenario 1: Upgrade underlying ML models for better implementation
Scenario 2: Retrain on new data generated over time for better predictions
ai_methodology.measuring_effectiveness: Establish baseline KPIs before AI deployment. Monitor same KPIs post-integration. Track conversion rates (click-through, sign-ups, purchases). Measure revenue impact (increased sales, reduced loan failures, cross-sell results).

data_privacy.anonymization: Strip Personally Identifiable Information (PII). No unique identifiers in datasets used for training.
data_privacy.federated_learning: Machine learning technique that enables organizations to train models on decentralized data. Models trained in your environment on your data without the data ever leaving the company's premises. ML models sent to client servers for local training on anonymized data. Models then hosted in client's own environment.

ai_for_lending.fair_lending: Flynx's AI models are trained on data that doesn't contain any features/variables that can potentially create bias in its predictions, thus making your business be automatically fairness-aware. Each product emphasizes Fair Lending Practices or Fair Lending principles integrated throughout.
ai_for_lending.flynx_reference: Flynx is the AI/ML engine referenced across LendingLogik's products. Flynx's AI models are trained to be fairness-aware with bias-free predictions.
ai_for_lending.technology: ML models trained on historical lending data, deployed via API on AWS/Azure/Google Cloud/Heroku. Supports federated learning and data anonymization. Integration with Salesforce/CRM via HTTP API requests.
